citations.assessment: The passage calls the house of learning Rabbi Apas’s academy in the account of Levi; the succession details come from the other sources.
Rabbi Apas is older by two and a half years. He sits at the head, and Chanina succeeds him on his death.
Rav infers Apas has died and Chanina now sits at the head after Levi comes to Babylonia.
Rashi’s wording gives two years. The additional half is attested in Ketubot, independently of the Tosafot inference about length of tenure.
The parallel names Rabbi Pas of the south and an unnamed elder. Chanina agrees to accept third place. Do not harmonize that sequence into the Bavli account.
